The '''Norclu Order''' was a sect that believed in [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] and regarded the<ref name="Tales14" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Norclune system/Legends|Norclune system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Norclune]] as holy.<ref name="Tales14" /> Members of the group had no possessions and wore floor-length [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Clothing/Legends|robes]].<ref name="Tales14" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Smuggler's Blues]]" takes place concurrently with the portion of {{Film|IV}} that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> six red [[Xando's species|aliens]]&mdash;including [[Gender/Legends|Brother]] [[Xando]]&mdash;were apart of the Norclu Order.<ref name="Tales14" />
